title: Nutty Rich German Egg Yolk Custard
description: A sweet and velvety German dish featuring egg yolks and a mother-sauce base, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and keto-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, whisk together the heavy cream, melted butter, vanilla extract, and swerve sweetener.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and salt until well combined.
Gradually add the hot cream mixture to the egg yolks, whisking constantly to prevent the eggs from scrambling.
Pour the mixture into 6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
